ammonia.reason: Limited urea/amino-acid deamination by NSLAB in 3-mo brine-salted cheese; ammonia not reported.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low Tyr/Trp degradation to p-cresol/indole not reported in pasteurized cow curd without washed rind.

bitter.reason: Chymosin/plasmin hydrophobic peptides partly debittered by Lactobacillus peptidases during maturation.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; 2-heptanone/2-nonanone not reported, no blue beta-oxidation pathway.

browning.reason: Low residual lactose/galactose limits Maillard reaction with lysine residues on heating.

buttery.reason: Citrate metabolism by Lactococcus diacetylactis to diacetyl 512-765 mg/kg measured with low reduction to acetoin 6-9 mg/kg.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate lipolysis by milk lipase and LAB esterases releasing butanoic acid 142-215 mg/kg measured.

creaminess.reason: Moderate fat ~25% wet, ~41-44% dm lubricates but pressed low-moisture matrix limits cream flow.

crumbliness.reason: Short-moderate proteolysis without grana crystallization retains cohesive elastic body.

firmness.reason: Pressed uncooked paracasein network at ~40.5% moisture with progressive moisture loss over 1.5-6 mo.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine catabolism by NSLAB to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol not reported.

fruity.reason: Limited LAB esterase esterification to ethyl butanoate/hexanoate not reported in 2-3 mo uncooked cheese.

goaty.reason: Predominantly cow milk with max 10% goat/sheep allowed and no caprine branched-chain acids reported.

malty_nutty.reason: NSLAB Strecker/aminotransferase catabolism of Leu/Ile/Val plus high propanoic acid 435-1757 mg/kg background.

melt.reason: pH ~5.3 demineralized Ca-paracasein with ~25% fat allows viscous flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Geotrichum/Penicillium camemberti; 1-octen-3-ol/one from linoleic acid oxidation not reported.

oil_off.reason: Moderate coalesced milk-fat pools exude free oil on heating, restrained by intact protein network.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; smoke phenol guaiacol not reported, no wood-smoke exposure.

sour_vinegar.reason: Heterofermentative LAB/NSLAB produce acetic acid 361-835 mg/kg measured in brine-salted uncooked curd.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; Ca-crosslinked uncooked curd does not align into fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked curd without high heat; no methanethiol/DMS reported, minimal Met demethiolation.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted; residual sweetness from propanoate, glycerol and sweet amino acids Pro/Gly/Ala.

umami.reason: Rennet/plasmin plus Lactobacillus peptidases release Glu/Asp during 2-6 mo proteolysis.
